24.text: In former times a kind of toboggan made of whalebone was used for

25.text: carrying meat over the ice, while at present the whalebone has too high a

26.text: market value to be applied for any such purpose. The model in the collection

27.text: (Fig. 22, c) is made of a single piece of whalebone, while the real toboggans

28.text: had several slabs laced together side by side.

29.text: At the present time an ordinary dog-team has six or seven pairs of animals

30.text: (Plate VIII, Figs. 1, 2; also Plate VI, Fig. 4). An odd dog is attached

31.text: separately, generally at the rear end; or, if the central strap is too long for

32.text: the number of dogs, two or three of them are attached separately. Chukchee

33.text: drivers going on a long journey borrow from their friends and relatives as

34.text: many dogs as they can, and thus have teams of from sixteen to eighteen

35.text: dogs. Even double teams of more than twenty dogs are used; though this

36.text: does not work well, because the foremost pair will hardly do their share of work,

37.text: and the whole team will lack in unity. Moreover, a double train requires two

38.text: drivers wherever the road is uneven, as on the hills and in the forests.
